common_mistakes.arithmetic-error: Adding figures without dated working, so a mid-period shortfall or total is miscalculated — re-add each figure line by line and state every calculation
common_mistakes.assumes-missing-information: Filling an unstated gap with a guess instead of naming it — list each fact not given and state what must be checked before deciding
common_mistakes.unverified-entitlement: Promising a refund, benefit, cover or right before checking the current official terms — verify entitlement against the official source first
